project_type: Tauri 2 desktop app (Rust backend in src-tauri, React 19 + TypeScript 6 frontend built with Vite 8). Not a monorepo. Repo root is /Users/anuwat.t/scrcpy-gui-plus, git branch main at start (HEAD 39a35dc). Do not push.
language: TypeScript (strict, tsc 6.0.3) for src/, Rust 2021 for src-tauri (local rustc/cargo 1.96.0)
build_system: npm scripts from package.json: `npm run build` = `tsc && vite build`; `npm run lint` = `tsc --noEmit`; `npm test` = `vitest run`. Rust: `cd src-tauri && cargo build` / `cargo test`. Cargo.lock is gitignored (.gitignore:81), so the `=` pin in Cargo.toml is the only committed pin. src-tauri/target already exists (debug), but first cargo build after adding rqrr can take minutes: pass an explicit long timeout (>= 900000 ms) or run in background.
test_framework: Vitest 4.1.11 with jsdom (vite.config.ts `test` block, globals:true, setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts which only imports @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest, css:true) + @testing-library/react 16 + @testing-library/user-event 14. Rust unit tests inline under #[cfg(test)] (see src-tauri/src/deep_link.rs lines 164+). jsdom has no layout: mock getBoundingClientRect/ResizeObserver; geometry is injected in tests.
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build   (Rust changes: cd src-tauri && cargo build)
test_command: npx vitest run   (scoped: npx vitest run src/components/qr-studio src/components/ui src/services src/navigation src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx ; Rust: cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib deep_link qr_device)
verification_instructions: Final gates (design.md section 10): `npx vitest run`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, and in src-tauri `cargo build` + `cargo test`. Also `cd src-tauri && cargo tree -d | grep -i '^image'` must show a single image version and `cargo tree -e features -i rqrr` must not list the `img` feature. Visual verification is manual/semi-automated (design.md 10.1) and must be reported honestly as PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN in .agents/tasks/qr-studio-verification.md. Jsdom cannot prove clipping/overflow/zoom behaviour.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. dist/ and src-tauri/target are build outputs (do not commit). Screenshots go to .agents/tasks/qr-studio-shots/ (not committed, .agents/ is untracked). Cargo.lock is gitignored.
environment_constraints: macOS, zsh. Quote globs: `grep -rn "qr-studio" src` (zsh fails on unmatched --include=*.rs globs). No ADB device is guaranteed: Rust adb paths cannot be unit-tested, only argument building/sanitising/hash/decoder. Vite dev server uses fixed port 1420 (strictPort); use `npm run dev:ensure` (scripts/ensure-vite.mjs) and never kill an already-running dev server. Web-only vite has no Tauri `invoke`, so Rust-backed features must degrade with an honest message there. Never `git add .agents`, never `git add -A`; stage specific files. Never push; commit locally.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md or .kiro/steering exist. README.md only documents run/build. Conventions: Conventional Commits (feat/fix/...), no new npm dependency (decided), exactly one new Cargo dependency `rqrr = { version = "=0.11.0", default-features = false }` (must be reported to the user). Other modules and other screens' modals/tooltips/z-index literals stay untouched. ThemedModal and legacy src/components/Tooltip.tsx are NOT migrated. Existing CSS vars --z-sidebar/--z-topbar/--z-drawer/--z-modal keep their values.
key_patterns: Service wrappers are thin `invoke<T>('cmd', {...})` functions (src/services/deepLinkService.ts: launchDeepLink, generateQrSvg). Tauri commands return result structs with success/error_code/error (src-tauri/src/deep_link.rs DeepLinkResult, helpers ok()/err()/err_msg()). Commands are registered in src-tauri/src/lib.rs invoke_handler next to `deep_link::generate_qr_svg` (~l.226). UI primitives in src/components/ui/ (Badge, Button, IconButton, Panel, SectionHeader, classNames.ts, index.ts barrel). Theme via data-theme on <html>; AppShell (src/components/app-shell/AppShell.tsx) root is opacity-animated and <main> is overflow-y-auto, so overlays must portal to body > #qr-overlay-root. Palette: navy #0d1725/#132031 panels, border #263244, accent #ff4f57 (see `accent`, `panelClass`, `inputClass` in the current QrStudioPage.tsx). Tests mock `../../services/deepLinkService` with vi.mock and use localStorage.clear() in beforeEach.
